content.title: Choose a conversation subject
content.summary: A private poll over predefined named options; votes cannot be changed.
content.setup: Agree on the activity windows; the host supplies resolved dates and eligible participants.
content.participant: Follow each instruction; submit or vote before its window closes.
content.completion: Finish after showing the vote result, including an unresolved tie or empty outcome when appropriate.
content.access: Ballots stay private. Options are visible when voting is entered; presented totals disclose counted participation and the option labels and identities.

provenance.rights: Rights to participant contributions remain with their authors; this package grants no media rights.
